summary:
Completed Phase 6 for transaction-service. Added `renovate.json`, a trusted-main weekly/manual dependency-submission workflow, `docs/dependency-automation.md`, and a README link. The workflow preflights `spring-platform` and `service-web`, uses basic caching, and separates package-read credentials from the submission token. No dependency pins, build configuration, or service logic changed.

Validation passed under Node 24: strict Renovate schema validation, actionlint, documentation links, diff checks, and unchanged dependency/build inputs. Renovate extracted 43 occurrences across eight files using Gradle, wrapper, Dockerfile, and Actions managers, including all three internal catalog coordinates; credential-free lookup returned 46 candidate branches with no unexpected diagnostics.

The official local graph generator succeeded with 91 coordinates, but no internal coordinates or complete runtime/test graph because authenticated `serviceCommon` 0.0.16 resolution was unavailable. Published-preset resolution, authenticated lookups, hosted graph submission, bot-PR CI, Dependabot settings, and alert evidence remain pending Phase 12 as documented in `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
